name: Sakaguchi Kazuki
source:
Kazuki is the childhood friend of [url=/c10661]Tomoka[/url] and one of her classmate. He also knows [url=/c10662]Saki[/url] through Tomoka but they doesn't really see each other. They was good friends before and Kazuki even propose to her, but since they start middle school, she becames more distant to him and she adopted the gyaru life style.

Kazuki doesn't know if he loves her anymore and secretly hope she didn't became an easy girl. He hopes to be close to her like before.
